intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
BIT Patna vs IIT Patna is not a single winner. IIT Patna has a recorded NIRF 2025 #19, and BIT Patna has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: BIT Patna vs IIT Patna for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose BIT Patna if you want a recorded fee of ₹3.6 lakh, and an admission route through JEE Main, in a public B.Tech setting at Patna.
Choose IIT Patna if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #19, and a recorded fee of ₹4.33 lakh, in a public B.Tech setting at Patna.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹3.6 lakh as a programme total for Bachelor of Engineering Information Technology at BIT Patna.
Our records show ₹4.33 lakh as a programme total for B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering at IIT Patna.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for BIT Patna here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for IIT Patna here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: BIT Patna is listed on our records with JEE Main as an admission route for this B.Tech comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
IIT Patna is listed on our records with JEE Advanced as an admission route for this B.Tech comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Bihar. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether BIT Patna's recorded ₹3.6 lakh or IIT Patna's ₹4.33 lakh fits your budget for this B.Tech.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether IIT Patna's recorded ₹4.33 lakh or BIT Patna's ₹3.6 lakh fits your budget for this B.Tech.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, BIT Patna or IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. BIT Patna and IIT Patna differ in more than one way: IIT Patna has a recorded NIRF 2025 #19, and BIT Patna has no NIRF rank on this page.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for BIT Patna vs IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹3.6 lakh for BIT Patna on Bachelor of Engineering Information Technology; our records list ₹4.33 lakh for IIT Patna on B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for BIT Patna and IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for BIT Patna here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do BIT Patna and IIT Patna accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list JEE Main for BIT Patna, and JEE Advanced for IIT Patna. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are BIT Patna and IIT Patna in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Patna, Bihar. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
